theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = ∫ x in E, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ
